subject: POC success criteria and final readout scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC recap + next steps (success criteria, owners, timeline)

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Great to chat earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed plan for the 2-week POC so we can align on success criteria and owners. Please review and confirm (or suggest edits) by EOD Wed 3/24 so we can lock dates.

Summary of goals
- Validate integration & latency for your main inference path (user -> Redwood -> model -> user) for the 95th percentile concurrency of ~50 QPS.
- Ensure end-to-end cost estimates for production (batching/quantization knobs).
- Verify data handling/security assumptions for telemetry and logs.

Proposed success criteria (will be evaluated during final readout):
1) Latency: 95th percentile tail latency < 250ms for 1k token requests under 50 QPS synthetic load.
2) Throughput: Sustained 40 QPS with <=10% error rate.
3) Quality: Sample prompt set ROUGE/Likert average >= baseline (we'll use your in-house prompts).
4) Operational: No PII leakage in logs; audit log coverage for test runs.

Owners
- Redwood (technical): Marcus Lin — integration, test harness, load scripts.
- Redwood (CS): Naomi Feldman — runbooks, monitoring dashboards, final readout facilitation.
- Acme (technical): Alex Rivera — dataset access, auth for test env.
- Acme (product): Sophie Chen — quality sign-off and exec readout.

Proposed timeline
- Week of 3/23: test env access + baseline smoke tests
- 3/24-3/31: POC execution (load tests + qualitative evals)
- 3/31: Final readout (30-45m) + go/no-go decision

Attachments:
- redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf (detailed test plan and checklist)

Next steps
1) Alex/Sophie: confirm success criteria and owners by 3/24 EOD
2) Acme: share test dataset access & service account credentials
3) Redwood: Marcus to confirm test scripts and Naomi to propose readout slots

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if anything needs clarifying.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — confirming on the tech side. Quick notes:

1) Test harness & benchmarks\- We'll run a 3-stage plan: smoke -> ramp -> sustained. Targets as discussed: 95th pctl <250ms, sustained 40 QPS. We'll provide load scripts and k6 configs.
2) Data / creds\- Alex: dataset samples in JSONL are fine; we need a service account with read-only access to the test bucket and an endpoint URL. If you have a staging key that expires after 7 days that's perfect.
3) Evaluation artifacts\- Attached: acme-eval-criteria.xlsx with the sample prompt list and the quality scoring rubric (Likert + pass/fail flags).
4) Infra notes\- For the synthetic load we recommend a 2x buffer (we'll run ramp to 100 QPS briefly). No additional infra required from Acme beyond the dataset access.

I'll own test script delivery by end of day 3/25. Naomi — once you propose readout slots I'll add dashboard links and a short walkthrough for the execs.

Attachments: acme-eval-criteria.xlsx
